context: Two managers prep an internal training session
purpose: Teach: 担っ/書き込ん/専念/県警/整合/図り/出題/一律

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 今度の研修、出題内容を一律にする?
lines.en: For the upcoming training session, should we standardize the exam content across all groups?
lines.style: Efficient, matter-of-fact opening. Slightly lifted at the end—checking in rather than mandating. Professional but collaborative tone. Quick tempo.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。整合性を図り、部署ごとの差をなくします。
lines.en: Yes. We'll ensure consistency and eliminate the gaps between departments.
lines.style: Steady, assured response. Measured pace. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. Professional register—speaking as a subordinate who has already thought this through.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料の書き込んでない箇所、専念して埋めて。
lines.en: The sections in the materials that aren't filled in yet—focus on completing those.
lines.style: Direct instruction, no frills. Slight emphasis on 'focus'—she wants quality attention here. Brisk but not unkind. The tone of someone delegating work to someone trusted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 担っ部分、明日朝までに完成させます。
lines.en: I'll have my assigned sections finished by tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Firm commitment without hesitation. Voice steady and low. Slight snap of certainty on the closing—he's already mentally done with it. Professional assurance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 県警からの来賓もいるから、形式整えて。
lines.en: There's a guest from the prefectural police attending, so make sure the presentation is polished.
lines.style: Quick shift to stakes. Light but clear emphasis on 'polished'—this matters. Still efficient, but the stakes are now visible. Pragmatic urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Crisp acknowledgment. Clean close. No extra movement. Professional finality.
